## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the TODO/issue and explain relevant compatibility or architecture decisions.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm lint`

List actual commands/results and any blockers. Leave a check unchecked when it did not pass. Default tests must not require provider credentials.

## Limits and follow-up

Describe remaining risk or required human decisions. Passing verification does not authorize public package/release publication or deployment. Report vulnerabilities privately through SECURITY.md.
